name: Fami☆Resu
source:
Main character hops into family restaurant "Magnolia" to have a midnight snack. The three waitress there behave in a totally unexpected way by taking provocative poses and encouraging flirting. How will it all end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公走进家庭餐厅“Magnolia”吃宵夜。店里的三名女服务员行为完全出乎他的预料：她们摆出挑逗姿势，还主动鼓励调情。事情最终会如何收场？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
